name: Cold Shoulder
tagline: The operating system for people who charge money to freeze other people.
positioning: Cold Shoulder runs the bookings, waivers, and water logs for your cold-plunge studio, so the only thing shivering is your members.

hero.h1: Run your plunge studio without losing your cool.
hero.sub: Bookings, digital waivers, memberships, and tub temperature logs in one place. You handle the ice. Cold Shoulder handles the paperwork nobody warned you about.

features.title: Slot booking that survives 6am
features.description: Members book 12-minute plunge windows, get auto-reminders, and no-show fees fire on their own. Your front desk stops playing air traffic control.

features.title: Waivers before wet feet
features.description: Signed liability waivers land in an inbox before anyone touches the water. No more clipboard hunts or 'I swear I signed one last week.'

features.title: Temperature receipts
features.description: Log every tub's temp on a schedule and keep a timestamped history. Great for the health inspector, greater for the guy who insists it 'felt warm.'

features.title: Memberships that don't leak
features.description: Plans, freezes, and family add-ons that actually bill correctly. Failed cards get chased automatically so you don't have to.

features.title: Staff seats, sane permissions
features.description: Give each coach their own login without handing over the keys to your bank account. Roles for front desk, coaches, and owners.

features.title: Numbers you'll actually check
features.description: Utilization by tub, revenue per member, peak plunge hours. Know whether that 5am slot earns its ice bill.

testimonials.quote: We were running three studios off a shared spreadsheet and a group chat. Cold Shoulder cut our no-shows by half and I stopped dreaming about double-booked tubs.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

testimonials.quote: The waiver flow alone paid for itself. Every plunger signs before they're in the building, and our insurance guy finally stopped calling.
testimonials.name: Dev Okafor

testimonials.quote: I gave my coaches their own seats and suddenly I'm not the only one who can check the schedule at 5am. Best per-seat money I spend.
testimonials.name: Hannah Re-Brandt

pricing.blurb: One location, the basics, and zero clipboards.
For the studio that's actually busy at 6am.
Many locations, one ice-cold command center.

homepage.footerBlurb: Cold Shoulder is the software for cold-plunge studios that would rather run the business than run around. Keep the water cold and the ops boring.
